'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Alright, soldier! I've got a mission for you from the Motherland! Need you to wipe out a gang or two of looters. Think that'll be easy? Don't get cocky. Keep your head down and get the job done. And don't forget to report back when it's over. No report, no reward.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 25 to start this quest.
* Obtain level 4 loyalty with [[Prapor]]

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 30 enemies with AK-74 series weapons on [[Reserve]] or [[Lighthouse]]

==Rewards==
*+65,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Armband (BEAR)]]
* 1× [[ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle]]
* 10× [[12.7x55mm PS12B (10 pcs)]]
*Unlocks purchase of [[ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
* +4 [[Mag Drills|Mag Drills skill]] levels

{{quote|Is it done? Great. Motherland won't forget this. Now take your reward and fuck off. I have a lot of work to do.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 30 hostiles with AK-74 series weapons. You can use any of the following: 
*[[AK-74]]
*[[AK-74M]]
*[[AK-74N]]
*[[AKS-74]]
*[[AKS-74N]]
